correctness.rationale: Each right vertex has zero/one/two/three chosen neighbors of three left vertices. Cycles prohibit degree-three together with another right degree>=2, equal paired two-neighbor supports, and three different degree-two supports. Hence only zero, one, or two compatible high-degree right vertices; yields Z_n=A^(n-2)[A^2+nBA+3n(n-1)b^4] with A=1+3b,B=3b^2+b^3. One-edge E and two-edge Q_R,Q_L,Q_D enumerations were inspected and the Rayleigh differences Δ=E^2-QZ independently recomputed exactly using polynomial arithmetic: Δ_R=b^4(n-1)P_R, Δ_L=2b^4P_L, Δ_D=b^4P_D. Each P has 15 strictly positive integer monomials in b and h=n-1; thus all three covariances strictly negative for b>0, n>=5. Independent source checker includes exact finite enumeration, but the general claim follows from symbolic identities and combinatorial classification, not a finite run.
